user.title: Connect to an Edifice ENT
user.description: Use the account you sign in with on your school's ENT. The password is stored in Home Assistant's configuration, like every other integration that needs one.

data_description.url: The address you type in your browser to reach the ENT, for example {example_url}
data_description.name: Optional. Names the device and its sensor, for example "School Emma". Defaults to the name of the class diary.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: {host} no longer accepts the saved password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_url: Enter the address of the ENT, starting with https://
error.invalid_auth: The ENT rejected this username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ENT. Check the address and try again later.
error.unsupported_platform: This does not look like an Edifice ENT with a homework diary. The address may be wrong, the ENT may sign in through an external service (CAS, EduConnect), it may be waiting for a password change or terms acceptance that must be done in a browser first, or the homework module may not be enabled.
error.no_diary: Signed in, but this account can read no homework diary.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: How often to read the ENT
init.description: Home Assistant reads the ENT every {default} minutes by default. Each reading is a handful of requests to your school's platform, so the lowest value allowed is {minimum} minutes. The Refresh button reads it once, right away.

data_description.scan_interval: Whole minutes. Saving reloads the integration.
